data.description:
## Context / Problem

`_REBAR_OVERRIDES` (src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:274) family-forces
`native_structured_output: False` for Claude — a blanket signed-contract posture. E1 (recorded
on the selection bug ticket) measured native structured output working on specific Bedrock
cells. The established mechanism for per-cell measured facts already exists:
`_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (capabilities.py:309), an exact-id table that wins over the
family default. Enable exactly the measured cells; every other cell stays fail-closed.

## Approach

Add `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` rows setting `native_structured_output: True` and
`native_output_with_thinking: True` (field introduced by the guard story) for the cells E1
measured PASS: `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` and
`bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0` (the dated profile id — the bare haiku
alias 400s at request validation; measured). Each row's comment cites its measuring run (E1
artifacts; harness workflow run id once available). Client-side Pydantic validators remain
mandatory on the native path — Bedrock's schema transform strips `ge`/`le` bounds (measured:
E1 emitted 1.0 out-of-bounds).

Explicit non-rows, recorded in the table comment: Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected
server-side by Converse structured output (provider rollout gap; re-measure trigger: rerun the
harness cell when AWS announces support). Direct-Anthropic and OpenAI cells gain rows only
from a harness matrix run measured PASS (operator-attested artifact); cells without
credentials at run time are recorded "unmeasured" and stay prompted.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py — the measured-cell rows + non-row comment
- tests/unit/ (capabilities test file) — config-effect contrast tests

## Testing

Unit tier, config-effect contrast through the real capability read path (resolve model id ->
capabilities -> `output_mode`):

- `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` with thinking=True -> NativeOutput.
- The dated haiku id with thinking=True -> NativeOutput.
- `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8` (no row) -> PromptedOutput (fail-closed negative
  control).
- An arbitrary unknown Claude id -> PromptedOutput (family default preserved).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both measured Bedrock cells return NativeOutput under thinking through the real read
      path — checked by the new contrast unit tests.
- [ ] Opus and unknown-id cells stay PromptedOutput — checked by the same tests.
- [ ] Every row comment cites its measurement evidence and the non-row comment records the
      opus re-measure trigger — checked in code review.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Any non-Bedrock row added under this ticket links its harness matrix
      artifact as a comment here; if none ran, the cells are recorded "unmeasured" in the
      table comment instead.
data.title: Enable native structured output for measured Bedrock model cells
